newsitem.title: UK: Granada gains after newpaper recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Granada gains after newpaper recommendation.

text.p: Shares in Granada Group Plc gained in early trade on Monday after a "buy" recommendation in the Mail on Sunday newspaper, dealers said.

The paper said the recent slide in Granada shares may be over, adding that its hotel interests should benefit from booming demand while its television operations stood to gain from a reduced government levy.
Granada shares were up 9-1/2p to 822 by 0746 GMT, extending a recovery since hitting a year's low of 735p on July 11. They have been under pressure since hitting a record 984p on March 12.
